name: k6-generic-performance-testing
description: Generic performance testing framework using k6

scripts.test: npm run bundle && k6 run dist/test.js
scripts.test:smoke: npm run bundle && k6 run -e SCENARIO=smoke dist/test.js
scripts.test:load: npm run bundle && k6 run -e SCENARIO=load dist/test.js
scripts.test:stress: npm run bundle && k6 run -e SCENARIO=stress dist/test.js
scripts.test:spike: npm run bundle && k6 run -e SCENARIO=spike dist/test.js
